description: An app's telemetry, told to its own machine's host as it happens (the phone's app to its own host), never on to another: what was done in chats, and what it profiled. Kept on that machine only (its state folder's telemetry/), while the host's telemetry is on. Its process id is how the host samples it.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

app.description: The app it's of: Baude, Record, or the phone's app.

events.description: What happened since it last told (each at its own time).

profile.description: What it profiled since it last told, if it's profiling.

profile_error.description: Why it isn't profiling what it's told to, if it isn't.
